A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the card-type bar and the game-text box) with the corrected game text, and below it a black strip with a white E, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 March 2017 (the PDF was made on 31 May 2017).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:DS2-L-twilightisuponme-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Twilight Is Upon Me]]: The game text changes: “[Death Star II]” is added. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with a white italic “E”.

The same area of the printed card (scaled to the slip's width) and the 2017 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
